summary: Mako Mining filed a Form 6-K on September 10, 2026, disclosing a mineral agreement with the Cooperative Republic of Guyana and the Guyana Geology and Mines Commission for the 100%-owned Eagle Mountain Gold Project. The agreement establishes legal, fiscal and operating stability for mining and prospecting licences and fiscal terms for an initial 10-year term, renewable by good-faith negotiation, with royalty, tax, training and local-content commitments consistent with prior Guyanese mineral agreements. No price, stake or ownership change is involved. The company continues permitting, with final ESIA expected Q4 2026 and a subsequent agency decision. This is a routine operational/regulatory milestone, not a special situation.
